# image-to-stl.com
# Free online image to STL converter for 3D printing.
# Convert JPG, PNG, SVG images to STL, OBJ, GLB 3D models.
# All processing happens in your browser.

Allow: /
Description: Free online image to STL converter. Convert images to 3D printable STL files in your browser. Supports heightmap, SVG extrusion, and lithophane modes. No uploads, no registration, free forever.
